data_source_notes.VT: Vanguard Total World Stock ETF. Added 2026-08-04 at the user's request. Unlike every earlier addition, no broker instrument search was run for VT before it was whitelisted -- the session that added it had no Robinhood access -- so state/tradeable/fractional_tradability/prior-close availability are UNVERIFIED. No new code path trusts this: the existing preflight and data-confidence gates resolve VT at run time and gate it out fail-closed if it does not resolve, exactly as they would for any other symbol. Confirm resolution on the first live run before treating VT as a normal member of the universe. VT also has no entry in the ticker-history archive, so its per_ticker_sizing calibration is the global fallback ladder (see config/per_ticker_sizing.json fallback_tickers).
data_source_notes.GFUZ: General Fusion Group Ltd. Common Shares. Robinhood is the primary data source: resolved active, tradeable=true, fractional_tradability='tradable', regular-hours dollar orders supported, prior close available. Finance connector ticker lookup returned NOT_FOUND, so finance data may be unresolved/unavailable for GFUZ.

GFUZ.reason: Finance (and other read-only market-data providers) may not resolve GFUZ. Robinhood is the primary quote/prior-close source for GFUZ; Alpaca/Finance/Yahoo remain read-only validation/context only.

supplemental_preflight.trigger: If the same-day 9:45 pre-flight artifact does not contain a GFUZ row (e.g. GFUZ was unresolved at 9:45), the 10:30 live task should run a supplemental GFUZ read-only validation before decisioning.
supplemental_preflight.note: Persist the supplemental read-only validation to gfuz_supplemental_preflight.json before any GFUZ signal/budget/order decisioning; the decision engine reads only from the persisted file.
supplemental_preflight.implementation_status: not_implemented: MorningDCAExecutor._apply_preflight_gate() has no code path for this today. A missing GFUZ row in the 9:45 preflight artifact simply gates GFUZ out (tickers ∩ eligible_tickers excludes it) for that run, a safe, fail-closed degradation, not the supplemental-validation flow described above. See config/morning_dca.json's gfuz_special_handling.supplemental_preflight.implementation_status for the authoritative note.
